title: plugin-approvals: sys_approval_request.record_id declares referenceDeletedWhen on cancel_reason = record_deleted (objectui#12489 letter A)
body:
Blocked-by: #23735

Filing gate: the services half of a maintainer ruling — objectui#12489, batch #352 item 4, letter A. Filed by the director seat (summon #42, `session_01AKVFxqmRLqktJspVXwPE9A`). ⛔ Not a claim; the lane and grade are the ruling's.

## What lands here

One line on `record_id` in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts`: `referenceDeletedWhen: { field: 'cancel_reason', value: 'record_deleted' }`, after the spec key exists (#23735). `cancel_reason` is already a declared `select` with the `record_deleted` option (`spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts:118`, label 「Related record deleted」). No page edit: the served page's Details tab draws the pair through `record:details`, and the renderer reads the key.

## Downstream

objectui#12489 (`pm:blocked` on this card) dispatches its step 4 once the spec is installable at objectui's pin: the pointer renderer draws the tombstone.

Dedupe: see #23735.
